project_title: Frasberg Mainnet Validator Software Console Design System

theme_strategy.design_archetype: Swiss & Precision Modern Dashboard (Clean, Calmer, High White-space)
aesthetic_goals: De-clutter interface by replacing harsh gridlines and noise overlays with soft, structural surfaces
Establish high visual contrast and calm readability with ample breathing space
Restrain JetBrains Mono usage strictly to hash, key, address, and terminal/log outputs
Establish a dual-section navigation model split into 'Public' and 'Operator' roles

font_policy: Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for 85% of standard text, labels, nav links, status titles, and table cells
Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' or 'Outfit' (font-heading) strictly for Page Titles (H1, H2) and Hero Stat numbers
Use 'JetBrains Mono' strictly for hex values, validator keys, block heights, IP addresses, JSON view, terminal outputs, and system logs
Avoid all-caps tracking-widest text over-saturation on standard labels

text_sizes.stat_value: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold font-heading text-[var(--text)] tracking-tight
text_sizes.code_snippet: font-mono text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[var(--surface-2)] text-[var(--text)]

sidebar_structure.container_style: bg-[var(--surface)] border-r border-[var(--border)] p-4 flex flex-col justify-between min-h-screen
sidebar_structure.nav_item_active: bg-[var(--primary-subtle)] text-[var(--primary)] font-medium rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-all border-l-4 border-[var(--primary)]
sidebar_structure.nav_item_inactive: text-[var(--text-2)] hover:bg-[var(--surface-hover)] hover:text-[var(--text)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-all

header_bar.style: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-[var(--surface)]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[var(--border)] px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm

cards_and_panels.standard_panel: bg-[var(--surface)] border border-[var(--border)] rounded-xl p-5 shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)] hover:border-[var(--border-strong)] transition-all duration-200
cards_and_panels.hero_stat_panel: bg-[var(--surface)] border border-[var(--border)] rounded-xl p-6 shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)] relative overflow-hidden

status_pills.ok: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-[var(--ok-bg)] text-[var(--ok)] border border-[var(--ok-border)]
status_pills.warn: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-[var(--warn-bg)] text-[var(--warn)] border border-[var(--warn-border)]
status_pills.bad: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-[var(--bad-bg)] text-[var(--bad)] border border-[var(--bad-border)]
status_pills.info: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-[var(--info-bg)] text-[var(--info)] border border-[var(--info-border)]
status_pills.violet: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-[var(--violet-bg)] text-[var(--violet)] border border-[var(--violet-border)]

buttons.primary: bg-[var(--primary)] hover:bg-[var(--primary-hover)] text-white font-medium text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors shadow-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[var(--primary)] focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-[var(--surface-2)] hover:bg-[var(--surface-hover)] text-[var(--text)] border border-[var(--border)] font-medium text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-[var(--bad)] hover:opacity-90 text-white font-medium text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-lg transition-colors

tables.container: overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--surface)] shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)]
tables.header_row: bg-[var(--surface-2)] border-b border-[var(--border)] text-left text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-muted)] uppercase tracking-wider
tables.body_row: border-b border-[var(--border)] hover:bg-[var(--surface-hover)]/50 transition-colors text-sm text-[var(--text)]

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (buttons, nav items, inputs, toggles, filter dropdowns) and primary key metric display blocks MUST include a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the CSS variables defined under 'light_mode_variables' into the :root selector and 'dark_mode_variables' into '[data-theme="dark"], .dark' inside index.css
Set light mode as default, with a header toggle button updating the data-theme attribute on document.documentElement and persisting in localStorage
Restructure the sidebar navigation into two clear, visually grouped headers: 'Public' and 'Operator'
Refactor hardcoded hex colors across all components to use var(--surface), var(--border), var(--text), var(--ok), var(--warn), var(--bad), etc.
Ensure all tables, cards, stat blocks, buttons, and nav links render cleanly in both light and dark modes with high legibility and appropriate padding.
